rounds.q: What % of the world's people live within reach of a 4G signal?
rounds.why: 5G already covers 55% of people, but only 4% of people in low-income countries.
rounds.fun: 93% of people can catch a 4G signal. That's a whole lot of bars! 📶

rounds.q: What % of people aged 10 and up worldwide own a mobile phone?
rounds.why: There's a gender gap: 87% of males own one versus 78% of females.
rounds.fun: 82% of people 10 and up own a phone. Ring ring, the whole world is calling! 📱

rounds.q: What % of the world's people used the internet in 2025?
rounds.why: That's 6 billion people, yet only 23% of people in low-income countries are online.
rounds.fun: 6 billion people online! Imagine them all hitting refresh at the same time. 🌐

rounds.q: What % of people use mobile internet on their own device?
rounds.why: That's 4.8 billion people. About 3.4 billion still don't use mobile internet at all.
rounds.src: GSMA Intelligence, State of Mobile Internet Connectivity 2026
rounds.fun: 4.8 billion people surf the web on their own device. Pocket-sized adventures! 🏄

rounds.q: What % of people have a mobile broadband signal but don't use it?
rounds.why: Only 3% of people have no signal at all, so most of the gap is people not using it.
rounds.src: GSMA Intelligence, State of Mobile Internet Connectivity 2026
rounds.fun: The signal is there, but 38% aren't using it. Hello? Anybody home? 📡
